name: Tensor Glyphs
aliases: Tensor Glyphs — Eigenvalue-based Glyphs, Superquadric Glyphs
definition: Objects at every data point representing scalar, vectorial, or tensorial information (eigenvalues/eigenvectors) to overcome the limitation of colormaps displaying only three metrics.
summary: Tensor Glyphs visualize tensor data using geometric primitives like superquadrics to ensure unambiguous, continuous representation of diffusion anisotropy, overcoming the limitations of ellipsoids and colormaps.
